heading: Retirement: retirement for years of service; selective early retirement

tree.heading: Retirement for Years of Service.—
tree.text: Sections 14507 through 14515 of this title shall apply to the retirement of officers in competitive categories of officers designated for purposes of this chapter.

tree.heading: Selective Early Retirement.—
tree.text: Section 14101(b) of this title shall apply to the retirement of officers described in subsection (a).

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 118–31, div. A, title V, § 514(a), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 248.)
